parameter_description: Selects the tone group; the MSB and LSB pair chooses between the internal, expansion and GM2 banks.
notes: Not received when the Rx Bank Select parameter (SYSTEM:MIDI) or the Rx Bank Select(BS) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF.

parameter_description: Sets the value of the parameter most recently selected by RPN.
notes: Only meaningful after an RPN has been selected with CC 101 and CC 100.

parameter_description: Applies the tone's assigned modulation depth.
notes: Not received when the Rx Modulation(MOD) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF.

parameter_description: Breath controller input for the part.
Foot controller input for the part.
Sets the time taken for the pitch to glide between notes.
notes: Not received when the Porta Time parameter (PART VIEW:PITCH) is OFF.

parameter_description: Sets the part's volume.
notes: Not received when the Rx Volume(VOL) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF. The Level parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Sets the part's stereo position.
notes: Not received when the Rx Pan(PAN) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF. The Pan parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Sets the part's expression level, scaling Volume.
notes: Not received when the Rx Expression(EXP) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF.

parameter_description: Positions the part left to right in the surround field.
notes: The Part L-R parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: Positions the part back to front in the surround field.
notes: The Part F-B parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: Sets the part's ambience send level.
notes: The Part Ambience Send Level parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: Positions the external part left to right.
notes: The PartEx L-R parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: Positions the external part back to front.
notes: The PartEx F-B parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: Sets the external part's ambience send level.
notes: The PartEx Ambience Send Level parameter (MOTIONAL SURROUND EDIT:PART) will change. Valid only when Motional Surround is ON.

parameter_description: General Purpose Controller 1; destination is set per tone.
General Purpose Controller 2; destination is set per tone.
General Purpose Controller 3; destination is set per tone.
General Purpose Controller 4; destination is set per tone.
General Purpose Controller 5; destination is set per tone.
General Purpose Controller 6; destination is set per tone.

General Purpose Controller 8; destination is set per tone.
Sustains the notes that are held when the pedal is pressed.
notes: Not received when the Rx Hold-1(HOLD) parameter (PART VIEW:MIDI) is OFF.

parameter_description: Switches portamento on or off.
notes: The Porta Switch parameter (PART VIEW:PITCH) will change.

parameter_description: Sustains only the notes already sounding when the pedal is pressed.
Softens the tone.
notes: The manual gives the range as 0-127 without documenting an on/off split, unlike Hold 1 and Legato.

parameter_description: Switches legato playing on or off.
notes: The Legato Switch parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Lengthens the release of the notes being held.
notes: A hold movement is not performed.

parameter_description: Glides from a specified source note to the next note played.
notes: The value is the source note number. A note-on received immediately afterwards glides from that note.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored resonance value.
notes: The Reso Offset parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored release time value.
notes: The Release Offset parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored attack time value.
notes: The Attack Offset parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored cutoff value.
notes: The Cutoff Offset parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored decay time value.
notes: The Decay Offset parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored vibrato rate value.
notes: The Vibrato Rate parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored vibrato depth value.
notes: The Vibrato Depth parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored vibrato delay value.
notes: The Vibrato Delay parameter (PART VIEW:OFFSET) will change.

parameter_description: Sets how much of the part is sent to the reverb.
notes: General Purpose Effect 1. The Rev Send Level parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Sets how much of the part is sent to the chorus.
notes: General Purpose Effect 3. The Cho Send Level parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Selects a Registered Parameter, whose value is then set with Data Entry.
notes: Four RPNs are received: 00H 00H Pitch Bend Sensitivity (0-24 semitones, LSB ignored), 00H 01H Channel Fine Tuning, 00H 02H Channel Coarse Tuning (-48 to +48 semitones), and 7FH 7FH RPN Null. This format has no RPN columns, so the numbers are recorded here rather than in cc_msb/cc_lsb.

parameter_description: Silences all notes sounding on the channel.
notes: Sent with a third byte of 00H.

parameter_description: Returns the channel's controllers to their reset values.
notes: Sent with a third byte of 00H.

parameter_description: Releases all notes held on the channel.
notes: Notes held by Hold 1 or Hold-2 continue to sound.

parameter_description: Treated as All Notes Off.
notes: The same processing is carried out as when All Notes Off is received.

parameter_description: Treated as All Notes Off; Omni mode is not turned on.
notes: The same processing is carried out as when All Notes Off is received.

parameter_description: Sets the part to mono and performs All Notes Off.
notes: The Mono/Poly parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.

parameter_description: Sets the part to poly and performs All Notes Off.
notes: The Mono/Poly parameter (PART VIEW:LEVEL/CH) will change.
